claims.statement: Tom Allen advertised free concerts every evening at his place at 619 Market street, St. Louis, with the best of singers only engaged.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN. retired champion pagilist of the worid, 619 Market street. Free concert evers evening.

claims.statement: Tom Allen styled himself retired champion pugilist of the world in a February 1891 advertisement.
claims.excerpt: TOM ALLEN. retired champion pagilist of the worid, 619 Market street. Free concert evers evening.

notes: Allen appears only in the Sporting Notes advertisement. The Van Auken robbery item at Pauline Lang's house does not involve him.
